summary: Dissolves any adhesive, even Sovereign Glue.
text: This tube holds milky liquid with a strong alcohol smell. You can take a Utilize action to pour the contents of the tube onto a surface within reach. The liquid instantly dissolves up to 1 square foot of adhesive it touches, including Sovereign Glue.
